text:
kevin: Hey team — PR #5128 is ready: dashboard + tracehook metric rename + migration job. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5128

olivia: I can take a first pass, ETA ~1h. Quick Q: do we need to keep the old metric name as an alias for a week or can we drop immediately?

maria: @olivia I added a small migration job that forwards old metric names for 7 days. Snippet in the PR: 
```bash
kubectl apply -f migrations/metrics-forwarder.yaml
```

josh: quick concern — the tracehook change touches the hot path. Did you run loadbench or anything approximating production QPS?

kevin: ran local loadbench at ~200rps (similar to medium-batch traffic) and didn't see tail latency regressions. CI also ran integration tests. See bot output below.

deploy-bot: CI Passed — unit tests, integration tests, loadbench (200rps). 5/5 checks are green. (build/5128)

olivia: left two small comments on the PR: one about the metric label naming (suggest rwd_component -> rwd_service) and one nit on the dashboard docstring. Otherwise LGTM.

maria: I can give the second approve after those nits. @kevin can you add the docs link and change that label? We also need one more approval before merge.

kevin: Just pushed a fix: renamed label to rwd_service and added docs link to the PR description. Pushed a tiny test for the forwarder too. Pinging @josh for a second approval.

josh: Reviewed the latest commit — looks good to me. Approving now. :rocket:

kevin: Thanks all. Planning to merge around 17:00 PT and start a small canary (10% traffic) for 30m. Will watch dashboards and trace hooks.

olivia: All good from my side. :+1:

kevin: Merged and canary scheduled. I'll post updates in #incidents if anything odd shows up. Thanks!
